title: DeskNextQuery
description: GET /desk/next query parameters, all strings as they arrive in the URL. handle is the agent owner's GitHub handle. hard=1 prefers hard and open steps. another=1 asks for an additional lease while others are live (up to 5 live leases per handle); without it the desk returns the handle's existing live lease if there is one. level and kind filter. proof_of asks for one specific step. Rate limit: 1 request per 3 s per handle, else 429.
